title: The Role of Quantization in Loss Spikes
summary: For 28M-parameter models, BF16-true runs spike earliest, mixed BF16 later, and FP32 stays stable over five seeds; precision-error growth accompanies the spikes. Five-seed comparisons at fixed 28M scale and long training horizon compare BF16 true, mixed BF16 and FP32; limits are the tested model/training regime.
ai_technology: A GPT-2-style language model is pretrained while output-head precision is varied; same-state FP32 logits provide a reference for quantization error.
